title: Farm Real Estate Loans Fee Schedule Note — Late-Charge Record Addition to the Homesite Release Premium
content:
On a farmstead split of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, a record addition is added to the release premium percentage of the homesite. It follows the late charges assessed on the loan in the last 24 months: two or more add 15.0 points; one adds 10.0 points; none adds nothing.

**What the records show.** The late charges assessed on the loan — fee entries marked as a late charge — dated in the last 24 months, as they stand on the loan's transaction history.

| Late charges assessed on the loan in the last 24 months | Addition to the release premium percentage |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| exactly one | 10.0 points |
| two or more | 15.0 points |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- One late charge assessed 6 months ago and another 30 months ago: only one falls in the last 24 months, so 10.0 points.
- Two late charges assessed 3 and 14 months ago: 15.0 points.
